ServiceDefinition.description: Service that returns a listing of machines that have the PTCSC.Utilization.ModelLogic_TS Thing Shape. This listing is limited to a maximum number of machines based on the UtilizationConfiguration "MaxEntitiesOnOverviewScreen" on the PTCSC.UtilizationTWImpl.Manager thing. If a listing of machines is passed in, it will just retun those machines.
ServiceDefinition.name: GetMachineListing

ServiceDefinition.description: Return utilization records for one machine over an explicit time window. Machine must be the canonical ThingWorx Thing name of the machine, not a display name, short equipment label, alias, or serial number.
ServiceDefinition.name: GetUtilizationRecordsByMachine

ServiceDefinition.description: Return utilization-state aggregates for the requested machine and time range: when the user specifies a machine, pass its exact Thing name as Machine; when the user specifies a date or period, pass the corresponding StartDate and EndDate; omit Machine only for an all-machine query, never silently broaden a machine-specific request to all machines, and set ShiftID only when the user specifies a concrete shift.
ServiceDefinition.name: GetUtilizationStateSummary
